The metadata is published or maintained by Science Data Bank. Coverage is at city scale in Colombia. Any further spatial resolution, complete time span or sampling interval beyond the details above is not verified here. The provider landing page describes access to SWMM INP, spreadsheets, geospatial layers material. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support resilience. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. The provider describes Storm Water Management Model (SWMM). Related catalogue records are model-epa-swmm.
